description: Typed TypeScript SDK for supported Tradernet API v2 user profile data, broker reports, user cash flows, portfolio snapshots, and read-only orders.
rules: Import TradernetApiClient, constants, and types only from @kofeinstyle/tradernet-sdk.
Check response.success before accessing response.data or error fields.
Use getUserProfile to retrieve homeCurrency and main_curr without exposing the complete getOPQ payload.
Use getBrokerReport with corporate_actions for security-level dividend details and getUserCashFlows for account ledger operations.
For account_at_start and account_at_end reports, read the snapshot from report.account.positions_from_ts.ps; there is no report.detailed array.
For historical account snapshot position values, use posval (q * mkt_price), not market_value or close_price, which may contain current quote data.
cash_flows and securities_flows broker reports return rows directly in response.data.report arrays; they do not use report.detailed.
Broker report amounts are already normalized to numbers; read cash_flows fields such as curr_flowed and curr_commissioned directly instead of wrapping them in Number().
Match cash_flows and securities_flows rows by curr or ticker; their order inside report is not stable.
Pass getUserCashFlows sort as a single { field, dir } object, not an array; Tradernet rejects the array form shown in its docs. filters remains an array.
getUserCashFlows rows have numeric sum, sumRaw, and balance; balance is the account balance in the row currency after that operation, so read it directly instead of wrapping it in Number().

KnownTransactionTypeCode covers the full broker type-code reference plus commission_for_other and commission_for_trades; TransactionTypeCode still accepts unknown codes, so do not reject rows with an unlisted type_code.
Use getPortfolio for the current read-only account balances and open positions.
Use getOrders for current-period orders and getOrdersHistory for an explicit date range.
Use OrderStatuses for documented order status codes; OrderStatus intentionally also accepts unknown numeric codes.
Use OrderOperations, OrderTypes, and OrderExpirations instead of unnamed numeric order codes.
Broker reports default to the 23:59:59 time period unless 08:40:00 is explicitly required.
Do not suggest API v3, WebSocket, order placement, or other methods that are not part of the documented public API.
